domain_diagnosis.independent_unit: file/group mean for source-target distribution statistics
class_structure: distance from each unlabeled target file to source class centroids after source z-standardization
domain_diagnosis.wording: MMD/PCA/domain classifier are domain-gap evidence only, never target-accuracy evidence

pseudo_target.adaptation_label_visibility: hidden; feature adaptation receives no class_label

simple_transfer_baseline.source_moments: file-balanced window weights from source training pool
simple_transfer_baseline.target_moments: file-balanced window weights from unlabeled pseudo-target only
simple_transfer_baseline.selection: maximize mean file Macro-F1 across loads0/1/2; tie-break higher mean min-class Recall then smaller alpha
simple_transfer_baseline.final_validation: evaluate selected alpha once on load3; no retuning afterward

promotion_and_failure.candidate_T2_trigger: T1 fails or is unstable AND covariance/domain evidence indicates residual multivariate shift
promotion_and_failure.candidate_T3_trigger: domain classifier AUC high AND target files show uneven overlap with source class/support structure

diagnostic_triggers.T2_CORAL_condition: T1 final held-load gain <= 0 OR T1 severe-failure, and (domain AUC>=0.75 or MMD2>=0.05).
diagnostic_triggers.T3_domain_weight_condition: domain AUC>=0.75 and fewer than 75% of target files lie within the nearest source-class p95 radius.

step08B_if_reached.rule: each family tuned only on pseudo-target loads 0/1/2 and evaluated once on held load3; no A-P truth
